rules.name: ANIMATION_PROFILE_NO_NEW_CAPABILITY_OR_AUTHORITY
rules.requirement: The profile MUST project the existing 143-capability catalog and MUST NOT create a new architectural authority.

rules.name: ANIMATION_PROVIDER_NEUTRAL_CONTRACT_REQUIRED
rules.requirement: All animation stages MUST exchange typed provider-neutral artifacts with content-hash lineage.

rules.name: ANIMATION_STAGE_TRANSITION_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED
rules.requirement: Every stage transition MUST bind source/result identity, operation, provider, media semantics, policy and QC evidence.

rules.name: BFORARTISTS_PRIMARY_BLENDER_VALIDATED_FALLBACK
rules.requirement: Bforartists is the primary human DCC frontend; Blender is an explicit validated compatibility fallback, never a silent route.

rules.name: OPENTOONZ_PRIMARY_TRADITIONAL_2D_REFERENCE
rules.requirement: OpenToonz is the primary traditional 2D/Xsheet/cel reference provider and its third-party components require separate license admission.

rules.name: MUSETALK_TYPED_ISOLATED_LIPSYNC_PROVIDER
rules.requirement: MuseTalk is the primary local audio-driven lip-sync reference behind a typed adapter and isolated runtime, not a ComfyUI custom-node dependency.

rules.name: VOICE_STT_MUSIC_EDITORIAL_FABRICS_DELEGATED
rules.requirement: TTS, STT, music, audio separation, DCC, editorial and resource semantics MUST delegate to existing FA3 profiles.

rules.name: OTIO_CANONICAL_EDITORIAL_TIMELINE_IR
rules.requirement: OpenTimelineIO remains the canonical editorial timeline IR; provider-local project files are not canonical roots.

rules.name: OCIO_CANONICAL_COLOR_BOUNDARY
rules.requirement: OpenColorIO is the canonical color-management boundary with an explicit config/transform identity.

rules.name: OPENEXR_CANONICAL_HDR_INTERMEDIATE
rules.requirement: OpenEXR is the canonical HDR scene-linear intermediate frame format; PNG remains an admitted bounded delivery projection.

rules.name: LICENSE_DIMENSIONS_SEPARATE_FAIL_CLOSED
rules.requirement: Code, dependencies, models, datasets, input/likeness rights and output rights MUST be separately recorded and all admitted for production.

rules.name: NONCOMMERCIAL_COMPONENT_PRODUCTION_DENIED
rules.requirement: Wav2Lip, released AudioCraft/MusicGen weights and F5-TTS pretrained weights MUST NOT satisfy a commercial production route while their noncommercial restrictions apply.

rules.name: VOICE_FACE_PERFORMANCE_CONSENT_REQUIRED
rules.requirement: Voice, face and character-performance use MUST carry purpose-scoped consent, reference hashes, retention policy and synthetic-media disclosure.

rules.name: HRB_LEASE_REQUIRED_FOR_ACCELERATOR
rules.requirement: Every local accelerator job MUST consume a valid Host Resource Broker lease; providers cannot self-place.

rules.name: GPU_UUID_AND_PCI_BDF_IDENTITY_REQUIRED
rules.requirement: Production GPU assignment MUST bind stable device UUID and PCI BDF; GPU0/GPU1 runtime indices are not identity.

rules.name: RTX3090_COMPUTE_A1000_DISPLAY_REFERENCE
rules.requirement: The T7910 animation reference declares RTX 3090 24 GiB compute and RTX A1000 8 GiB display roles; this declaration is not runtime evidence.

rules.name: DISPLAY_GPU_NOT_IMPLICIT_COMPUTE_FALLBACK
rules.requirement: The RTX A1000 display role MUST NOT become an automatic heavy-AI fallback.

rules.name: VRAM_HEADROOM_AND_BOUNDED_CONCURRENCY
rules.requirement: Admission MUST reserve workload-specific VRAM headroom and bound concurrent heavy GPU jobs.

rules.name: OOM_FALLBACK_EXPLICIT_ONLY
rules.requirement: OOM handling may fail, queue, retry or explicitly degrade; device, provider, precision or cloud fallback MUST NOT be silent.

rules.name: LIVE_CPU_NUMA_TOPOLOGY_REQUIRED
rules.requirement: The 2x E5-2696 v4 44C/88T T7910 declaration MUST be revalidated from live lscpu/sysfs topology at admission.

rules.name: PHYSICAL_CORE_FIRST_THREAD_BUDGET
rules.requirement: Animation workers MUST consume FA3-CPU-NUMA-THREADING-001 physical-core-first per-workload budgets and MUST NOT use global 44/88-thread defaults or static CPU IDs.

rules.name: KDENLIVE_ARDOUR_HUMAN_FINISHING_PRESERVED
rules.requirement: Kdenlive remains the primary Linux human editorial/picture-lock frontend and Ardour remains the primary human final-audio surface.

rules.name: FINAL_LOCK_QC_PROVENANCE_REQUIRED
rules.requirement: Final master requires picture lock, audio lock, color, caption, A/V sync, delivery QC and complete provenance.

rules.name: NO_RUNTIME_MODEL_DOWNLOAD_OR_FLOATING_PROVIDER
rules.requirement: Production provider code, dependencies and models MUST be immutable and pre-admitted; runtime downloads and floating refs are forbidden.

rules.name: CURRENT_HOST_PASS_NOT_DOCUMENT_DERIVED
rules.requirement: Canonical records and CI/reference PASS MUST NOT claim installed-provider or real T7910 animation-production E2E PASS.

rules.name: DISABLED_OPTIONAL_PROVIDER_ZERO_COST_NONBLOCKING
rules.requirement: Disabled optional providers MUST have zero or near-zero runtime cost and absent optional-provider runtime evidence MUST NOT block global promotion.
